title: Culture
description: Reference schema for docs/timeline/SPEC.md §7.1's Culture node type — a named cultural/ethnic/linguistic grouping, the anchor a GenderSystem (§7.7) attaches to via culture_id. Entities aggregate claims; they assert nothing on their own — every substantive statement about a Culture lives in a linked Claim (subject_type: Culture, subject_id: this entity's id), not inline here. The hand-rolled validator (docs/timeline/scripts/validate-timeline.mjs) is authoritative if this file and the validator diverge.

name.description: Common name used across the app, e.g. 'Yoruba', 'San (Ju/'hoansi and related groups)', 'Kongo'. Where a name covers a cluster of related groups, note the scope in `notes` rather than inventing a single umbrella claim.

region.description: Lane tag(s), SPEC.md §4. 'Middle East'/'Near East' banned as ancient-period labels.

date_range.description: Optional attested-existence window for the culture as named/documented — not a claim of ethnic continuity across the whole span.

latest.description: null for cultures understood to persist to the present.
